//: Template for the MCP servers this kit expects. They live in ~/.claude.json (NOT in ~/.claude/), so they are not installed by copying files — register them with `claude mcp add` (see README). Replace every <placeholder>; never commit a real URL, token or connection string.
//local: LOCAL scope, one set per project: each points at one client's Grafana or database, so register it from inside that project's folder with `claude mcp add --scope local <name> ...` (it lands under that project's entry in ~/.claude.json). One entry per environment: <env> is prod, stg, dev. Database servers are read by the db-analyst agent through SELECT-only tools; point them at a read-only login.
